description: This PHP source file defines the class JobSpecificationAttachmentDecorator, which is a decorator for the JobSpecificationAttachment entity. It provides methods to access the file content of a job specification attachment, potentially converting resource streams into strings.

classes.name: JobSpecificationAttachmentDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for JobSpecificationAttachment that provides access to the attachment's file content, handling both string and resource types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a JobSpecificationAttachment instance.

methods.name: getFileContent
methods.description: Retrieves the file content from the JobSpecificationAttachment. If the content is a resource, it converts it to a string using stream_get_contents.
